extraction_notes: The order directs parties to settle amicably and file consent terms within 15 days, disposing of the complaint with liberty to the complainant to approach again if settlement fails. Specific monetary reliefs (refund, interest, compensation) were sought but not granted by this order; rather, the process for settlement of these issues was directed.
